name: Kinetic Trap
//: MoM fork primed trap (2026-11-07).  visibility -1 = every character sees it.  action spell -> mom_kinetic_trap_trigger -> mom_primed_trap_hit marker -> Lua (allies spared; trap removed + damage on anyone else).  No remove_on_trigger: Lua removes it only when it actually detonates.  trigger_weight high so dropped items don't matter (item-only triggers no-op anyway).
